# JCT Cleaning Services

> Cleaning company in the Tri-Cities area of Washington (Kennewick, Pasco, Richland, West Richland). Cleans houses, apartments, rentals and offices. Rated 5.0 on Google from 7 reviews.

## Services
- House cleaning: weekly, every other week, monthly or one time
- Deep cleaning: extra time on kitchens, bathrooms and high-touch areas; on request the inside of the oven, light fixtures, sink drains, dishwasher filters and windows
- Move-in and move-out cleaning
- Apartment turnover cleaning between residents for property managers
- Commercial and office cleaning

## Service area
Kennewick WA, Pasco WA, Richland WA, West Richland WA.
